diagrams.title: From subject to 3D scene
diagrams.summary: Viewer adapts a subject and its transforms into an observable scene without acquiring its identity.

nodes.label: Canonical subject
nodes.description: The observed object remains owned by its domain.

nodes.label: Scene snapshot
nodes.description: Transforms and visible objects are derived.

nodes.label: 3D port
nodes.description: The renderer receives a stable contract.

nodes.label: Explicit renderer
nodes.description: Three.js projects the scene without acquiring authority over the subject.

diagrams.caption: Camera, framing, and view transforms remain projection state.
